title: A2A_State_Schema
description: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) shared state and handoff message schema for the LangGraph Evaluator-Optimizer multi-agent system at CapitalTrust Securities.

draft_report.description: The current draft of the financial brief generated by the Analyst node.

sources_cited.description: List of sources used by the Analyst (e.g., CBE Circulars, EGX summaries).

reviewer_feedback.description: Feedback provided by the Reviewer node against CapitalTrust regulatory criteria. Used to self-correct hallucinations.

approval_status.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the draft passes the Reviewer's assessment and is ready for the Human-in-the-loop (HITL) pre-publish gateway.

scratchpad_memory.description: Intermediate reasoning steps for Agentic RAG and MCP tool calls to maintain state across the LangGraph cycles.

market_context.description: Additional metadata regarding current EGX and EGP status.

examples.draft_report: CapitalTrust Morning Brief: Following the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) Circular No. 45/2023 on monetary policy tightening, the overnight deposit rate has been adjusted to 19.25%. Real-time EGP to USD exchange rates currently sit at 47.85 via the official interbank market. The Egyptian Exchange (EGX) is responding positively; the EGX30 index shows a 1.2% increase driven heavily by the banking sector. Commercial International Bank (COMI.CA) and QNB Alahli (QNBA.CA) saw a trading volume spike of 15% above the 30-day average. Analysts note that mid-cap equities in the real estate sector (e.g., TMGH.CA) may experience short-term volatility until secondary CBE guidelines are released regarding foreign currency allocations for developers.
sources_cited: CBE Circular No. 45/2023: Monetary Policy Tightening
EGX Daily Summary Data: COMI.CA trading volumes (2023-10-25)
EGX Daily Summary Data: QNBA.CA trading volumes (2023-10-25)
MCP Tool Response: Live EGP/USD Exchange Rate (CBE API Endpoint)
CapitalTrust Internal Guideline: High-Net-Worth Portfolio Rebalancing
CBE Press Release: Flexible Exchange Rate Policy Updates (Archive)
EGX30 Index Performance Data - Close of Market 2023-10-24
examples.reviewer_feedback: The draft accurately references CBE Circular No. 45/2023 and the current EGP/USD MCP tool fetch. However, verify the 15% volume spike for COMI.CA to ensure it strictly aligns with the EGX daily summary CSV. The phrasing regarding TMGH.CA must be categorized as 'Analyst Speculation' rather than stated fact to adhere to our strict anti-hallucination policies. Please revise the real estate volatility claim.

scratchpad_memory.tool_input: latest monetary policy circular overnight deposit rate
scratchpad_memory.observation: CBE Circular No. 45/2023 states overnight deposit rate increased to 19.25%.
Current official interbank rate is 47.85 EGP/USD.

scratchpad_memory.tool_input: COMI.CA QNBA.CA TMGH.CA volume and trend
scratchpad_memory.observation: COMI.CA up 1.2%, high volume. QNBA.CA up 1.1%. TMGH.CA volatile.
Initial draft generated and sent to Reviewer node.

scratchpad_memory.tool_input: Evaluate initial draft against CapitalTrust guidelines.
scratchpad_memory.observation: Reviewer flagged TMGH.CA phrasing and COMI.CA volume metric. Rejected.
